name: Superfire | 1.2g Infused Preroll | Grape Biscotti
description:
Ignite your day with Superfire Infused Pre-Rolls. Infused with premium oil and natural terpenes that burn smooth and delicious through to the very end. Whether you’re chilling at home or hanging with friends, these pre-rolls bring the perfect mix of flavor and potency. Light up, relax, and enjoy the blaze

1.2g Pre-Roll - Premium Distillate and Natural Terpenes - 20 Strains

Grape Biscotti: Experience the rich and decadent flavor of Superfire’s Grape Biscotti Infused Pre-Roll. Infused with premium oil and natural terpenes, this hybrid strain offers a smooth, balanced high perfect for relaxing or socializing. Indulge in the sweet notes of grape and cookie and elevate any occasion with every puff!
